fields.subject: Model Mapping
fields.trigger: one of the typed-result query-result handlers, Mapper.ModelFromOutResultsHandler or Mapper.ModelFromReaderResultsHandler, receives a root model and zero through eight typed dependent reader result sets named by its TReaderResult type arguments
fields.response: materialize the root model from output parameters (ModelFromOutResultsHandler) or from the first reader row (ModelFromReaderResultsHandler), materialize each available dependent result set as a list, and assign compatible result lists to the root model
fields.postcondition: these typed-result handlers use an empty list for each dependent result set that is absent from the reader (NextResult returns false), so a query that returns fewer result sets than the handler's type arguments is tolerated. This does not apply to Mapper.ModelFromReaderWithCollectionsHandler, which hydrates CollectionMapAttributeBase properties and throws UnexpectedSqlResultException for an absent result set instead, because those properties are written back as table-valued parameters and an empty list would read as 'no children'.
